parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: overall coupling strength of V1 to the top quark, c_t, benchmark value, Eq. (1)

parameters.name: th
parameters.description: chirality angle theta with tan(theta) = c_R/c_L, benchmark theta = Pi/2, Eq. (1)

parameters.name: Ptop
parameters.description: generation projector onto the top quark, Ptop[ff,gg] = delta[ff,3] delta[gg,3]; makes V1 top-philic

parameters.name: WV1
parameters.description: total width of V1 into t tbar, Eq. (2), in GeV

particles.full_name: top-philic color singlet vector resonance V1

lagrangian_terms.name: LV1kin
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu, nu}, -1/4 FS[V1, mu, nu] FS[V1, mu, nu] + 1/2 MV1^2 V1[mu] V1[mu]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LV1int
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{mu}, ct Cos[th] uqbar.Ptop.Ga[mu].ProjP.uq V1[mu] + ct Sin[th] uqbar.Ptop.Ga[mu].ProjM.uq V1[mu]]
